commitResults.messageTitle: Chatbot greets the user and exit
Chatbot can add items to list and list it
Add error handling and additional requirements

commitResults.messageBody:
Move the banner, separators, command input, and repeated task-added response out of Pixel and into a dedicated Ui class.

Route the remaining console messages through Ui without changing observable behavior. This creates a focused input/output boundary and is the first incremental step toward a smaller orchestration class.

Move the configurable data path, task loading, record validation, and atomic file saving out of Pixel and into a dedicated Storage class.

Keep Pixel responsible for orchestration and user-facing save errors while preserving the existing relative OS-independent path, storage format, and console behavior.

Introduce TaskList as the owner of the in-memory ArrayList and centralize add, delete, lookup, index validation, mark, and unmark operations.

Update Pixel to use task-list operations and Storage to serialize the wrapper directly. This removes direct collection mutation from the orchestrator while preserving command behavior, ordering, and the saved-data format.

Move command recognition, argument extraction, task-number conversion, date parsing, delimiter validation, and task construction out of Pixel and CommandType into a dedicated Parser class.

Keep Pixel responsible for executing parsed commands and displaying responses. Consolidate the three task-creation paths while preserving all existing validation messages, command syntax, and observable behavior.

Promote Ui, Storage, Parser, TaskList, and loading warnings to Pixel fields initialized by a Path-based constructor, and move the console session into run().

Reduce main() to supplying the default relative OS-independent data path. This establishes stable collaborators that future Command objects can receive during execution without changing observable behavior.

Add an abstract Command execution contract that receives TaskList, Ui, and Storage collaborators and provides a default non-exit state.

Move the farewell and exit signal into ExitCommand, then update Pixel to terminate through Command.isExit(). This establishes the stretch-goal command API while deliberately leaving other commands in the existing dispatcher for later incremental migration.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract list and unknown command behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Add ListCommand to render the numbered task list and UnknownCommand to own the unrecognized-command response, both through the shared Command execution contract.

Replace the corresponding response logic in Pixel while leaving parsing, separators, and all state-changing commands untouched for later incremental migration.

Add DateCommand with a parsed LocalDate so it owns matching-task traversal, original list numbering, the first-match heading, and the no-match response.

Keep raw date validation in Parser and reduce Pixel to constructing and executing the query command while preserving invalid-date handling and console formatting.

Add command objects for task creation, marking, unmarking, and deletion, and centralize safe persistence for mutating commands. Make Parser the factory for every supported command so Pixel can use one parse-execute-exit loop while preserving existing console output and failure handling.
